questionnaire.cooldownTitle: Da fatan za a jira kafin sake yin gwaji

questionnaire.enterResponse: Da fatan za a shigar da amsa kafin a ci gaba.
questionnaire.selectResponse: Da fatan za a zaɓi amsa kafin a ci gaba.

fieldWorker.description: Ayyukan tantancewarku a taƙaice. Kowace tantancewa da kuka yi na taimakawa gano haɗurran lafiya a cikin al'umma.
fieldWorker.questionnaireDescription: Kammala tantance haɗarin lafiya ga mutumin da kuke taimakawa.
fieldWorker.noAssessmentsYetBody: Ba ku gudanar da wata tantancewa ba tukuna. Fara ta farko domin taimakawa gano haɗurran lafiya a cikin al'umma.
fieldWorker.waitingForLocationAccess: Ana nemo wurin ku… Da fatan jira.
fieldWorker.locationPermissionPrompt: Wannan tantancewa na buƙatar wuɗin ku don hana aika bayanai sau biyu. Danna maballin da ke ƙasa don ba da izini — burauzarku zai tambaye ku.
fieldWorker.locationRequiredBody: Ana buƙatar izinin wuri don aika tantancewa. Ana amfani da shi ne don hana tattara bayanai sau biyu. Da fatan za a kunna izinin wuri a saitunan burauzarku sannan ku sake loda shafin.
fieldWorker.recentSubmissionDetectedBody: An riga an yi aika bayanai daga wannan wuri cikin {minutes} {unit} da suka gabata. Don hana tattara bayanai sau biyu, ba za ku iya fara sabuwar tantancewa daga nan yanzu ba.
fieldWorker.startNewAssessmentAfter: Za ku iya fara sabuwar tantancewa bayan {time}, ko kuma ku {move}.

Q1.text: Wannan bincike zai taimaka wajen fahimtar buƙatun kiwon lafiyarku, tare da tabbatar da cewa al'ummarku na da kayan aiki kamar magunguna, kayan haihuwa, kayan daukar jinin al'ada, hanyoyin hana daukar ciki, da jinya ta kyauta a lokacin ambaliya. Amsoshin ku sirri ne. Za mu iya farawa?

Q10.text: Kuna da nakasa? Idan eh, bayyana.

Q11.text: Shin kun lura da waɗannan alamu kwanan nan? Yi alama kan duk wanda ya dace.

options.discharge: Zubar jini ko wani abu mara kyau daga al'aura, ko wari
options.sores: Rauni, kumburi ko kuraje a baki ko al'aura
options.burning: Jin kunnawa ko ƙonawa lokacin fitsari
options.pain_sex: Jin zafi ko zubar jini yayin jima'i ko bayan sa
options.fever: Zazzabi ko yawan zufa da dare
options.yellow_eyes: Rawaya a idanu/fata ko fitsari mai duhu sosai

Q12.text: Yaya tsawon lokaci da wannan ke faruwa?

Q13.text: Shin alamun da ke sama suna taɓarɓarewa, sun kasance iri ɗaya, ko suna kyautatuwa?

Q14.text: Yaushe ne kuka je gwajin jini na HIV ko wasu cututtuka?

options.last_6_months: A cikin watanni 6 da suka wuce
options.more_6_months: Fiye da watanni 6 da suka wuce

Q15.text: Shin kun sami abokin jima'i a cikin shekara guda da ta wuce?

Q16.text: Sau nawa kuke iya amfani da kwaroron roba?

options.never: Ba na taɓa amfani da shi

Q17.text: Kwanan nan, shin wani ya tilasta ko danna ku yin jima'i ba da son ranku ba?

Q18.text: Shin kun taɓa yin jima'i don samun kuɗi, abinci, kyaututtuka, ko wurin zama?

Q19.text: Shin abokin jima'inku yana da wasu abokan jima'i ko wata matsalar lafiya da kuka sani?

Q20.text: Shin ba ku amfani da wani hanyar kariya daga cututtukan jima'i (STI) ko hana haihuwa?

options.want_but_no_access: Ina so amma ba ni da damar samun shi

Q21.text: Wanne ne kuke amfani da shi? Yi alama a duk abin da ya dace.

Q24.text: Yaushe ne kuka je kula da masu juna biyu (antenatal) ta ƙarshe a cikin wannan ciki?

options.last_month: A cikin watan da ya wuce
options.more_3_months: Fiye da watanni 3 da suka wuce

Q25.text: Mene ne ke hana ki zuwa antenatal?

options.not_aware: Ban san ayyukan saɓis na antenatal din ba

Q26.text: Shin kun fuskanci waɗannan a wannan ciki ko a cikin haihuwa da ta wuce? Yi alama a duk abin da ya dace.

options.swelling: Kumburi a ƙafafu, hannaye, ko fuska
options.blurred_vision: Raunin gani (kallon abubuwa ba a sarari)
options.bleeding: Zuban jini da ba a saba ba ko mai yawa

Q27.text: Shekarun ki a ciki na farko?

options.under_18_or_over_35: Ƙasa da shekara 18 ko fiye da shekara 35

Q28.text: Menene tazarar haihuwa tsakanin kowane ɗa (in kuna da 'ya'ya 2 ko fiye)?

options.over_2_years: Fiye da shekara 2 ko ina da ɗa ɗaya kaɗai

Q29.text: In kuna da ciki yanzu, ina kuke shirin haifa?

options.traditional: Tare da mai haihuwa na gargajiya (TBA)

Q30.text: Shin kina shirye-shiryen haihuwa amma ba ki da kayan haihuwa (sabulu, hannu na roba, gyale, tufafin jariri, hula, takalmi, tawul, matuƙin haihuwa)?

Q31.text: Inda kika haifa 'ya'yanki (In ba ki da ciki yanzu amma kin haifa a baya)?

options.traditional: Tare da mai haihuwa na gargajiya (TBA)

Q34.text: Wane rukuni ne ke cikin haɗarin matsalolin lafiyar jima'i da haihuwa (SRHR) a lokacin ambaliya? Yi alama a duk abin da ya dace.

Q35.text: A lokacin ambaliya, waɗanne suna samuwa a wuraren mafaka na wucin gadi? Za ku iya zaɓa fiye da ɗaya.

options.violence_reporting: Hanyoyin ba da rahoton cin zarafi

Q36.text: A lokacin ambaliya, shin an sami rahotanni na cin zarafin mata a al'ummarku?

Q37.text: Shin waɗannan suna samuwa a cibiyar lafiya a al'ummarku? Yi alama a duk abin da ya dace.

Q38.text: Shin cibiyar lafiya tana kusa da ku?

Q39.text: A lokacin ambaliya, shin kuna iya isa cibiyar lafiya mafi kusa, ko hanyoyin sun cika da ruwa?

Q40.text: Shin an sami damar samun magunguna a lokacin ambaliya da ta wuce?

Q41.text: In kuna da yara ƙasa da shekara 5, shin wani daga cikinsu ya rasa allurar rigakafi kwanan nan saboda ambaliya?

options.no_children: Ba ni da yara ƙasa da shekara 5

Q42.text: Za a iya samun taimakon lafiya da magungunan kariya cikin kwanaki 3 bayan cin zarafin jima'i, domin hana kamuwa da HIV, cututtukan jima'i, ko ɗaukar ciki?

Q43.text: Shin ana aika gargaɗi kafin ambaliya ta faru?

Q44.text: Da fatan za ku ba da bayanin hulɗa domin ƙungiyoyin agajin su isa ku da kayayyaki ko tallafin kiwon lafiya na gaggawa a lokacin ambaliya. Lambar Waya / WhatsApp (Na zaɓi).

Q45.text: Shin za a iya amfani da amsoshin ku ba tare da suna ba don sanar da ƙungiyoyin agaji su kawo kayayyaki da ƙarin likitoci da jiyo ga al'ummarku kafin ambaliya?

PS1.text: Yaya sauƙin fahimtar tambayoyin da aka yi?

PS2.text: Yaya kalmomin da aka yi amfani da su wajen bayyana cututtuka, alamomi, ko sassan jiki suka yi daidai da abin da mutane ke kira su a wannan al'umma?

options.1: Ba su yi daidai ba kwata-kwata

PS3.text: Yaya tambayoyin da aka yi a wannan bincike suka nuna gaskiyar yanayin lafiya a yankin da matsalolin lafiya da ke damun ku, iyalinku, da al'umma baki ɗaya?

PS4.text: Kuna da wata shawara don inganta wannan bincike ko kama gaskiyar yanayin lafiyar al'umma daidai?

PS5.text: Akwai wata matsalar lafiya ko yanayin gida da wannan bincike ya rasa gaba ɗaya?
